value.summary: This change refactors a test fixture to replace an `EpisodeState::opened(...)` invocation with explicit `watermark` and `round_start` fields. The new `round_start` is set to `Sequence(u64::MAX)`, with a comment explaining that a single-round hive sees the boundary above every row. Without seeing the definition of the `EpisodeState` type, the `watermark` field type, or the `Sequence` constructor, I cannot verify that the structural shape and value assignments are correct. The change looks sound in principle, but the correctness depends on types I cannot check.
